scope: Exact keyword collisions plus near-synonym diversity review. This file does not change production semantics.

governance.keyword_rule: Each rune keeps three two-character keywords, but the three should cover distinct semantic dimensions rather than merely repeat synonyms.
governance.collision_rule: Exact keyword reuse across different runes should be removed when it weakens semantic ownership. Positive and reverse keyword sets must not reuse the same token when that destroys polarity priority.
governance.classification_priority: lexical role / polarity direction -> group subjectivity -> rune semantic ownership -> direct-expression-over-opposite-side inference

positive_exact_collisions.reason: 彩直接描述多元色彩與層次；魂的核心是多種靈性聚合成承載體。
枝直接表達 branching；分應聚焦拆分／區分行為。
樹目前明確定位為成熟個體與表率；老描述歲月與生命歷程。
雷直接描述突發衝擊／警醒／警告；禍應描述災禍、危機與風險本身。
The generic token is too broad. 星 needs positive future potential; 無 needs unfixed/open unknown state.

near_synonym_review.finding: Three terms mostly restate domain/range; classifier gains little extra dimension.
Three center/core synonyms; consider one core noun plus importance/essence dimensions.
Three direction synonyms; should preserve direction ownership while adding a distinct orientation dimension.
Closely clustered ending/severing terms; check whether permanence, immediacy, and severance can be represented separately.
Three realization synonyms; should distinguish insight, internalization, and sudden realization if retained.
Strong overlap around ending; may benefit from death / closure / irreversible endpoint dimensions.
All three describe unconstraint; consider preserving freedom plus one physical/style dimension without invading 氣=流動.
Three period/stage synonyms; should remain distinct from 時=time and 緣=timing while adding one structural period dimension.
Three clarity synonyms; direct core is correct but keyword diversity is weak.
All time-related; less severe because they represent continuum, point, and measurement, but keep under review.
Three cause synonyms. English Cause is resolved, but Chinese keyword diversity still needs a separate semantic pass.
虛缺 and 缺少 overlap; keep distinction from 空=Space and 無=Blank as the governing constraint.

next_action: Review candidate replacements in semantic groups, then apply approved changes first to LunaRune66.xlsx mother data and regenerate runes66.json / runtime projections.
